question: What claim is being made about the locus and nature of the wind that fills, in relation to all beings?
premises: There is air described as wind-filling.
That air is situated in all beings.
The participle indicates its state of being situated there.
inference: The wind-filling air is claimed to be situated in all beings.
uncertainties: It is not specified whether this situation is permanent or functional.
plain_english: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
